summary.text: Tri Ta is a Republican member of the California State Assembly from District 70 who took office on December 5, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former mayor of Westminster, he was born in Saigon, Vietnam.

paragraphs.text: Tri Ta was born in Saigon, Vietnam, and lives in Westminster, California.
He earned a degree in international relations from California State University, Los Angeles.
Ta was elected to the Westminster City Council in 2006, was selected as mayor pro tem in 2008 and was elected mayor in 2012.
He was re-elected to the Assembly on November 5, 2024, defeating Democrat Jimmy Pham, 54.7 percent to 45.3 percent.
In the June 2, 2026 primary he received 53.8 percent and advanced to the general election against Democrat Paula Swift.

For 2025 and 2026 he was vice chair of the Local Government Committee and the Revenue and Taxation Committee, and a member of the Appropriations, Governmental Organization, Housing and Community Development, Rules, and Utilities and Energy committees.
